text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
Shopkeeper, do you have the nectar of the underworld fruit?
The one with the usual crest.

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
"The greatest mocktail starts with the ingredients...
The only thing that can satisfy my palate today
is that bottle...!"

text_block_list.name: Liquor Store Owner
text_block_list.text:
Oh, Gim-kun! Sorry about this~,
looks like that's suddenly been discontinued...
We don't carry it anymore~.

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text: To suddenly disappear without saying a word...

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
Ha... So, the only place left for us to meet
is within an illusion, is it?
Yet another unforgettable regret rains down upon me...

There was no time to say a proper goodbye.
Tanino Gimlet was secretly downcast, having failed to cherish the final moments...
